topics.title: Armory Castle Owns the vCenter Zero-Day
topics.latest_developments: CISA added CVE-2026-123890 to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on November 20, 2026, hours after Google tied the zero-day to the China-nexus group Armory Castle.
topics.why_it_matters: vCenter manages an organization's ESX hosts and virtual machines, so one authentication bypass rated 9.8 hands an unauthenticated attacker the whole virtual estate.

details.label: What to do
details.text: Broadcom shipped fixed builds for every supported branch and lists no workaround. Patch now, then hunt for intrusion activity reaching back to early September 2026.

details.label: Between the lines
details.text: Dark Reading reports the group likely held this bug in reserve during the last round of major vCenter updates.

details.text: Transport for London pulled its photocard site offline on November 16, 2026. Roughly 265,000 Oyster photocard holders may have lost account details.

details.label: What to do
details.text: Rotate every credential used with N-able's hosted mail services. Ireland's Data Protection Commission has logged more than 40 credit union notifications tied to Belfast-based Wellington IT.

topics.title: F5, Ruby, and SonicWall Force an Edge Patch Cycle

topics.why_it_matters: BIG-IP fronts corporate applications, and SonicOS 6.x now receives no fixes at any severity while AI-assisted scanning finds unsupported edge devices faster than ever.

details.label: What to do
details.text: Patch BIG-IP and upgrade Ruby. Pull Gen 6 and Gen 6.5 appliances off the internet edge and replace them.

topics.title: Cairn Finds a Zero-Day in a Medical Imaging App
topics.latest_developments: Amazon researchers said a China-linked actor ran the open-source AI framework Cairn against two universities, where it found an unknown flaw in a medical imaging application.
topics.why_it_matters: Bug discovery at machine speed now hits niche internet-facing software, where no vendor patch cycle moves fast enough to protect clinical and research systems.

details.label: Zoom in
details.text: Cairn chains reconnaissance, exploitation, and follow-on actions with little human direction, and the operator used it to take over the imaging server.

details.label: The big picture
details.text: Cairn joins Artex, CyberStrikeAI, and PentAGI as frameworks state-backed crews already run operationally.

topics.title: European Commission Confirms an AI-Assisted Intrusion
topics.latest_developments: Commission spokesperson Thomas Regnier confirmed at Thursday's midday briefing in Brussels that intruders misused a publicly available AI tool, forcing the Commission to pull several applications offline.
topics.why_it_matters: An off-the-shelf AI hacking tool worked against the European Union's executive arm, which moved services offline despite running its own emergency response team.

details.label: Zoom in
details.text: CERT-EU identified the tool as Artex, the open-source AI hacking platform the FBI warned about in the hands of criminals and state-sponsored groups.

details.label: What they're saying
details.text: Regnier told reporters the Commission has found no evidence anyone took data, and he declined to say which systems went down.

sources.title: European Commission Confirms AI-Assisted Cyberattack Disrupted Services

topics.title: Cisco Expressway Falls to a Public Proof of Concept
topics.latest_developments: CISA added CVE-2026-76466 to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on November 20, 2026, labeling the Cisco Expressway flaw rated 9.8 a use of hard-coded credentials.
topics.why_it_matters: Expressway carries video and collaboration traffic at the network edge, and the attackers breached four clustered devices at a Russian organization and staged tooling for lateral movement.

details.label: What to do
details.text: Patch every node, then inspect clustered peers for attacker tooling, because compromising one cluster member exposes the rest.

details.label: Zoom in
details.text: The same CISA batch added SAP NetWeaver CVE-2025-42884 and Apache Roller CVE-2026-129448 as actively exploited.

sources.title: Hackers Exploit Critical Cisco Expressway Flaw, Breach Four Devices and Reach Internal Network

topics.title: Bell Canada Blames an Agentic Hacker
topics.latest_developments: Bell Canada confirmed that an agentic threat actor breached its systems on November 17, 2026 and stole enterprise customer data, including records from a circuit ordering and provisioning system.
topics.why_it_matters: Circuit provisioning records map which businesses buy which connectivity, and Canada's largest carrier now attributes the theft to an AI-driven intruder.

details.label: The big picture
details.text: Bell Canada joins the European Commission in naming an AI tool as the attacker's engine within one week.

sources.title: Bell Canada says 'agentic' hacker stole enterprise customer data

topics.title: Linux KVM Hands Guests the Host's Memory
topics.latest_developments: Researchers used CVE-2026-99312 in KVM, the hypervisor built into the Linux kernel, to read about 127 gigabytes of a DigitalOcean server's memory from inside their own virtual machine.
topics.why_it_matters: On a shared host, that memory can hold other customers' virtual machines, which breaks the tenant boundary cloud customers pay for.

details.label: What to do
details.text: The flaw reaches only AMD hosts with nested virtualization enabled. Roll out the fixed kernels and turn nested virtualization off where no workload needs it.

sources.title: Linux KVM Flaw CVE-2026-99312 Lets Guest VMs Access Host Memory on AMD Hosts

topics.title: Cairncross Leaves the White House Cyber Post
topics.latest_developments: Sean Cairncross is leaving the White House as national cyber director, and Kirsten Davies, the Pentagon's chief information officer, takes the job in an acting capacity.

details.label: Between the lines
details.text: The handoff lands while President Trump's pick to run the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency, LoSapio, still awaits Senate confirmation, leaving both top civilian cyber jobs unsettled.

around_teams.why_it_matters: McCarthy's 6-3 team visits the Philadelphia Eagles Sunday, November 22, at 1 p.m. Eastern on CBS, a building where Pittsburgh has not won since the Lyndon Johnson administration.

team_usa.title: Callaghan Deflects the USMNT Job Questions
team_usa.latest_developments: Nashville SC head coach BJ Callaghan said Friday, November 20, that he stays "100%" focused on the MLS playoffs amid links to the United States men's national team vacancy.
team_usa.why_it_matters: U.S. Soccer's search for Mauricio Pochettino's successor now reaches an MLS coach in the middle of a playoff run.

sources.title: Nashville coach Callaghan '100%' focused on playoffs amid USMNT links

team_usa.title: Pochettino's USMNT Send-Off
team_usa.latest_developments: ESPN published its account of Mauricio Pochettino's farewell to the United States men's national team Friday, November 20, and Pochettino said he wants a say in Manchester United transfers.
team_usa.why_it_matters: U.S. Soccer must now hire a coach before a home World Cup, and fringe midfielders get a fresh audition.

details.label: Flashback
details.text: Pochettino left after Christian Pulisic's bicycle kick beat Haiti Tuesday, November 17, and carried the Americans into a Concacaf Nations League semifinal against Mexico.

details.label: What's next
details.text: Steve Cherundolo runs the December camp on an interim basis while the search continues.

team_usa.title: The NWSL Championship Lands at Audi Field
team_usa.latest_developments: ESPN published its championship predictions Friday, November 20, naming Washington Spirit forward Trinity Rodman the player to watch in Saturday's final against the Kansas City Current.
team_usa.why_it_matters: The Spirit reach their third straight final, and the result decides the National Women's Soccer League title in front of a home crowd in Washington.

details.label: When
details.text: Saturday, November 21, at Audi Field in Washington.

details.label: What they're saying
details.text: Kansas City defender Kayla Sharples said the Current peak at the right time and sit better positioned than last year's stronger squad.

team_usa.title: Dike Goes Down as Orlando's Season Ends
team_usa.latest_developments: United States forward Daryl Dike suffered an injury minutes after he came on as a substitute Thursday, November 19, as FC Cincinnati beat Orlando City 3-1.
team_usa.why_it_matters: Another layoff clouds Dike's availability as the United States resets its roster plans without Mauricio Pochettino.

details.label: Zoom in
details.text: The MLS Cup Eastern Conference wild-card loss ended Orlando City's season.
